snippet.title: Hoard's LLC: Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Hoard's LLC: Limited Labyrinth Corporation is a cute puzzle game where you rotate dungeon tiles, dodge workplace hazards (and spike traps!), and help Barry build a community one monster at a time. 

Corporate policy says "avoid unnecessary cross-departmental entanglements"
Barry says "maybe it's time to unionize."
_____________________________
